title: Formalizing Fefferman's Official Periodic Navier-Stokes Problem (B) in Lean 4: Global Linear Strain Exclusion on T3, Biot-Savart Direction Depletion Identities, and Conditional Reductions via Beale-Kato-Majda
description:
Erratum (v1.5.0). In v1.0–v1.4 the hypothesis PeriodicDirectionDepletionBound ν asked for a two-sided derivative (DifferentiableAt) of M(t) = ‖ω(t)‖∞ at every t ∈ [0, T], including t = 0. The kernel-checked theorem old_periodicDirectionDepletionBound_unsatisfiable proves that this old form (kept as PeriodicDirectionDepletionBoundOriginal) is false for every ν, so Q5 and clay_B_exact_of_torus_direction_depletion were vacuously true in v1.0–v1.4. v1.5.0 replaces it by continuity of M on [0, T] and a right derivative at each s ∈ [0, T) bounded by CCZM2 − κ''M3. The regression jumpPath_oneSided_depletion_clause checks that the counterexample path satisfies the corrected clause. Whether the corrected hypothesis holds for all smooth periodic data is open. All results are conditional; this is not a resolution of the Clay problem.

Lean 4 (leanprover/lean4:v4.30.0-rc1, Mathlib 0c154d67103f74be3a0f2c509f72ccbf5be9f2a7) formalization of Fefferman's periodic Statement (B), with unconditional identities Q1–Q3 and conditional reductions Q4, Q5 packaged in fefferman_periodic_ns_exact_reduction_product_theorem. 236 theorem/lemma declarations in source across 7 modules (Lean sources as of commit 8c40f83d7d8b52b2141506063952e2ebb3ed425a), 0 sorry, and AxiomAudit.lean reports all 243 audited names depend only on [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] or no axioms.
